threads.body: Slack notifications now mention every login in `facts["reviewers"]`, but that list intentionally includes anyone who reviewed/commented (and even non-team approvers). This can spam people who already approved (and may ping non-team users if they’re in the Slack map). Prefer notifying explicit PR assignees (the expected reviewers) and only fall back to reviewer statuses that actually indicate action is needed (e.g., changes requested / open thread).
